display_long_description:
ExR Education is brought to medical professionals by three founders who are experts in their retrospective fields. One a practising surgeon, one a triple-A games artist, and the final a film maker. Each of their skillsets enables them to create immersive experiences that can replicate real-life medical scenarios to boost the technical competencies of learners for medical procedures and processes. This, in turn, has led to a breadth of brilliant clinical educators to reach students and trainees at unprecedented scale. 

ExR Education’s aim is to democratise access to medical virtual reality. The content is designed for the user’s needs, to empower medical professionals with training that is vital to their skill development. To do so, all the content hosted on the ExR platform is co-created with professionals, whether that be NHS hospitals, care facilities, universities, medical device manufacturers or healthcare charities. 

The platform comprises of an array of medical training VR content that is free to all NHS professionals, and healthcare students. The collections include learning in the following specialty domains:

- Orthopaedics
- Anaesthetics & Intensive Care Medicine
- Ophthalmology
- Medical Equipment & Device Operation 
- General Medicine
- Core Medical & Nursing Skills
- Basic Life Support (BLS)
- Trauma Training 
- Air Ambulance Apparatus & Procedures
- Renal Medicine 
- Otolaryngology (ENT Surgery)
- Obstetrics
- Allied Health Professionals
- Paediatric Emergency Skills
